_comment: Roadmap for task lane:web (🗺). One step = {id, lane: 1|2|3|c|bench, title, deps, stage (column, left to right), how (when it is done / the command)}. Edit per contest (the hub commits it). bench steps B1..B4 and P1 are ticked automatically from the ops panel's scored runs; the others with task lane:step ID=… STATE=doing|done|skip. Optional "auto": {branches, not, files} (fnmatch globs; * crosses /): task hub:ship marks the step done with NOTE "PR #n" when a merged PR's head branch matches branches (and no not) or one of its files matches files (lanes.py autostep). Optional "done_on": [regex] (re.search on the one-line message): when the step's lane sends a matching [PR] / [DONE] / [PICK] (SendMessage via cchook.py, or task lane:msg) the step is done with the message as NOTE (lanes.py msg_steps). B1..B4 are also ticked when a bench ends (「終わった」 on the bench todo, or runs:wait's scored run; lanes.py bench_step). An automatic done wins over a manual todo / doing. 前半（コンテスト開始 → 3 回目のベンチ）だけを描く。ループ（parallel-fix / deep-dive の繰り返し、12:30 / 15:00 / 16:00 の区切り）は描かない。
